label: SAID_OF_2: T is truly SAID_OF_2 s in any way, including accidentally or denominatively
definition: t is truly said of s in any way, including accidentally or denominatively (as 'white' of a man).
note: Recorded for contrast only (DISAMB-PREDICATION-OF-DIFFERENTIA). No formalized statement uses it. Topics VI.6 or Posterior Analytics on per se predication would source the distinction if it becomes load-bearing.
